## Framework and version

Provide the framework name, version or publication date, and the relevant control or section identifiers.

## Authoritative source

Link the official publication or primary source. Note any access or licensing restrictions that affect quotation or redistribution.

## Mapping requested

Describe which repository controls, checklists, or templates should be mapped and why the relationship is useful.

## Mapping strength

Indicate whether the proposed relationship is direct, partial, supporting, or organisation-dependent. Do not claim that using this repository automatically establishes compliance or certification.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exact framework identifiers and version details are recorded.
- [ ] The mapping explains the relationship and its limitations.
- [ ] Partial or indirect mappings are labelled clearly.
- [ ] Legal, regulatory, or certification interpretation is not presented as final advice.
- [ ] Related README navigation and release notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] Repository validation passes.

## Scope boundaries

List anything intentionally excluded from the request.
